status_reason: Reuses docs/LOAD_CALIBRATION_PROTOCOL.md's six-region grid and knee criterion definition for the real engine, but the SLO/goodput input (per-request slo_deadline/weight overlay, needed to compute slo_violation_rate_real) is not yet attached by the real-vLLM collection layer (docs/REAL_SYSTEM_METRIC_MAPPING.md marks ANWG UNAVAILABLE today). Do not execute this calibration until that attachment lands and the workload manifests in Section D exist.
reference_policy_rationale: Mirrors the simulator's fifo reference (docs/LOAD_CALIBRATION_PROTOCOL.md): simplest mechanism, no priority/deadline synthesis dependency. Already built and validated (Wulver job 1219334, pass_gate=true, --scheduling-policy fcfs, no --scheduler-cls).

knee_search.source_of_definition: src/robustbench/ranking_portability/calibration.py::compute_lambda_ref (Phase-11, frozen); reused as a search-shape definition only, never its numeric lambda_ref result

slo_violation_rate_real_definition.formula: 1 - (sum(weight_i for i in completed if t_done_i <= slo_deadline_i) / sum(weight_i for i in completed))
slo_violation_rate_real_definition.slo_deadline_source: carried through unmodified from the frozen Phase-12 window's SYNTHESIZED_IMPUTED overlay (docs/DATA_FIELD_PROVENANCE.md) -- never resynthesized for the real run
slo_violation_rate_real_definition.blocking_prerequisite: attach per-request slo_deadline/weight to real-vLLM requests and compute t_done-vs-slo_deadline client-side; not yet built in calibration_common.py / vllm_openai_client.py

failure_handling.rule: a candidate factor whose measurement run has zero completed requests (crash, timeout) is treated as slo_violation_rate = 1.0 for that factor

warmup.rule: one untimed warmup request per server start before any measured candidate factor; discarded from all statistics

workload_manifest_hashes.note: populated once docs/RQ6_REAL_VLLM_WORKLOAD_MANIFEST_CONTRACT_20260902.md's generator exists and produces frozen manifests
